items.text: All 9 workshop decisions (5 from round 1, 4 from round 2) have been incorporated into the plan. Section 5 now contains a complete settled decisions table covering both rounds. Section 8 (Implementation Strategy) no longer contains any pending references — all phases reference concrete settled decisions by ID.

Key plan updates from round 2 synthesis: (1) Section 7 (Target End State) now names concrete files per layer (policy_access.go, policy_ratelimit.go, policy_circuit.go). (2) Section 9 adds a File Layout subsection showing the full middleware directory structure. (3) Phases 2 and 3 now include explicit PruneState methods per R2-d4. (4) Phase 3 specifies lightweight ResponseWriter wrapper (not httptest.ResponseRecorder) for status code observation. (5) Phase 1 now explicitly includes extracting access logic from policy.go into policy_access.go. (6) Section 13 adds a new prohibition against keeping all layers in a single file.

Readiness assessment: All 5 dimensions score 3/3. Problem clarity is high — the exact bugs and missing functionality are identified with line numbers. Scope is fully bounded with clear in/out-of-scope lists. Approach is solid with 5 ordered phases, all decisions settled, and concrete file/function names throughout. Testability is strong with 10 test categories covering all new functionality plus regression. Risk awareness covers all identified risks with mitigations. The plan is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated all round-2 decisions: separate files per layer (R2-d1), 5xx-only failure detection (R2-d2), nested http.Handler wrapping (R2-d3), prune-on-snapshot state cleanup (R2-d4). Removed all 'pending' markers from implementation phases. Added file layout section, PruneState methods to phases 2-3, and updated non-goals with file separation requirement.
